title: Approver Key
description: An approver key the server trusts, or trusted, to sign approvals. source is code for keys listed in the server's code, and governed for keys added through approver changes.

revoked.description: true: every approval signed with this key is refused.

source.description: code: listed in createApprovalIssuerRegistry.ts, changed only by a deploy. governed: added through POST /approval-issuers/changes.

addedByChangeId.description: governed only: the approved change that added it.

revokedByChangeId.description: governed and revoked only: the approved change that revoked it.
